$comment: Project -> workspace-root mapping used by cover/lib/cover.sh.
A 'project' is a SET of top-level Cargo workspace roots. Coverage for a
source file is attributed to exactly the project whose workspace OWNS it
(cargo metadata --no-deps), so a cross-workspace path dependency stays with
its owner (e.g. every compositor root links compositor.model, but the model
roots: an explicit list of repo-relative workspace roots, OR the string '*'
meaning 'every discovered workspace root minus .exclude'. '*' keeps the
compositor project correct as kernels/expansions/extensions are added.
Discovery = any dir (depth 1-2 under compositor.*/) whose Cargo.toml has a
[workspace] table; compositor.website is not a Cargo project so it never appears.
